definitions.explanation: A person or organization that runs a business. Commonly used in legal and regulatory contexts to refer to any entity conducting commercial activity.

examples.japanese: {事業者|じぎょうしゃ}は{法律|ほうりつ}を{守|まも}る{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: Business operators have an obligation to follow the law.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}への{支援|しえん}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: Support for small and medium-sized businesses was announced.

examples.japanese: {通信|つうしん}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}はサービスの{品質|ひんしつ}を{維持|いじ}しなければならない。
examples.english: Telecommunications operators must maintain the quality of their services.

notes:
USAGE:
{事業者|じぎょうしゃ} is a formal term frequently appearing in laws, regulations, and official documents. It covers both individuals and corporations conducting business.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: small and medium-sized businesses
- {通信|つうしん}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: telecommunications operator
- {個人|こじん}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: sole proprietor
- {飲食|いんしょく}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: food service operator
- {事業者|じぎょうしゃ}{向|む}け: aimed at businesses (B2B)
